newsitem.title: USA: Riggs EPS drops from higher tax, settlement.
newsitem.headline: Riggs EPS drops from higher tax, settlement.

text.p: Riggs National Corp said Wednesday its decrease in second quarter earnings was a result of increased income tax, as well as nonrecurring income from tax settlements during the second quarter of 1996.

The company reported earnings of $0.25 per share compared to $0.62 for the same period a year ago. Its earnings per share for the first half of the year were $0.50 compared to $1.23 for the same period a year ago.
The company said it had $7.8 million of increased taxes in the 1997 quarter, and $5.1 million of income from tax settlements in 1996.
It also said its decrease in earnings for the first half of 1997 was the result of $11.8 million of increased income taxes in the first half of 1997.
It also was the result of $11.1 million of nonrecurring income from tax settlements and net securities gains realized in the first half of 1996.
